forms.model.runtime.description: Form values are initialized from static values, page store, global store, or data model. Editing the form does not write back to those sources automatically; submit sends the current values as payload.
forms.model.definition.python:
```python
form_values = {
    "title": "Static onboarding",
    "owner": "Ada",
    "priority": "medium",
    "notify": True,
}

form = sdk.ui.Form(
    "project_form",
    model=[
        {"name": "title", "type": "text", "label": "Title"},
        {"name": "owner", "type": "text", "label": "Owner"},
        {"name": "priority", "type": "select", "label": "Priority", "options": options},
        {"name": "notify", "type": "checkbox", "label": "Notify team"},
    ],
    values=form_values,
    submit_label="Submit values",
    action="components.form_model_submit",
)
```
forms.model.definition.yaml:
```yaml
- kind: Form
  id: project_form
  values:
    type: store
    scope: page
    path: /components_forms/model/page_values
  submit_label: Submit values
  action: components.form_model_submit
  model:
    - {name: title, type: text, label: Title}
    - {name: owner, type: text, label: Owner}
    - name: priority
      type: select
      label: Priority
      options:
        - {label: Low, value: low}
        - {label: Medium, value: medium}
        - {label: High, value: high}
    - {name: notify, type: checkbox, label: Notify team}
```

flow.page_state.description: Client store scoped to the current page. It is useful for UI state that should disappear when the user leaves the route.
flow.page_state.overview: The page store lives on the client and is scoped to the rendered page. Use it for filters, selected tabs, draft values, temporary rows, or action results that only make sense while the current route is open. It is not a server session and should not be treated as persistent application state.
flow.page_state.table.navigation: Cleared when the current page changes
flow.page_state.table.usage: Filters, drafts, selection, local preview state

builder.set_store("/orders/filter", "open", scope="page")

flow.page_state.lifecycle: Page store values are client-side and route-scoped. Seed initial values from `render` with `builder.set_store(..., scope="page")`, then change them through action responses or stream bindings. To reset a key, write the default value or `None` to the same path.

flow.global_state.overview: The global store also lives on the client, but it is shared by every page in the current client session. Use it for shell state, active workspace, current language, notification counts, or data that multiple routes must read without refetching. Do not use it for durable persistence; persist domain data through module actions and storage.

flow.events.title: Events
flow.events.description: SDK event slots and listeners for decoupled communication between modules.
flow.events.overview: Events are application-level module signals. A module declares a slot as the producer contract, emits that event from an action or command, and other modules register listeners without importing the producer. Use events for domain notifications, lifecycle hooks, and cross-module reactions. Use runtime streams instead when the UI needs a continuous live feed.
flow.events.concept.slot: Declares a named producer contract and optional payload keys.
flow.events.concept.listener: Registers a callback for a qualified event name.
flow.events.concept.emit: Fires an event with an optional payload and awaits registered listeners.
flow.events.definition.title: Slot and listener
flow.events.definition.slot:
```python
from democrai.sdk.client import active_sdk as sdk


@sdk.event_slot(
    "order.completed",
    params=["order_id", "total"],
    optional=True,
    description="Order completed by the module.",
)
def register_order_completed_event():
    return None
```
flow.events.definition.listener:
```python
from democrai.sdk.client import active_sdk as sdk


@sdk.event_listener("orders.order.completed", priority=10)
async def on_order_completed(order_id=None, total=None, module_sdk=None):
    if module_sdk:
        module_sdk.system.log(f"order={order_id} total={total}")
```
flow.events.emit.title: Emitting
flow.events.emit:
Emit from an action or command through the SDK facade. Relative names are qualified with the current module name.

```python
await module_sdk.events.emit(
    "order.completed",
    payload={"order_id": order_id, "total": total},
    session=session,
)
```

Listeners can accept payload keys and supported runtime parameters such as `session`, `module_sdk`, `event_name`, or `payload`.
flow.events.discovery:
Use discovery when a module wants to list the contracts exposed by other modules.

```python
slots = sdk.events.get_event_slots()
orders_slots = sdk.events.get_event_slots("orders")
qualified = sdk.events.qualify_event_name("order.completed")
```
flow.events.api.qualify: Returns the fully qualified event name for the current module.
flow.events.api.slots: Reads registered event-slot definitions, optionally filtered by module.
flow.events.api.emit: Emits a module event with payload and optional explicit session.
flow.hooks.title: Hooks
flow.hooks.description: Render-hook slots and providers for UI extension points between modules.
flow.hooks.overview: Render hooks let one module expose a named UI insertion point and let other modules contribute components to it. The slot owner still controls where the returned components are mounted. Use hooks for optional UI extensions, not for replacing ownership of a page.
flow.hooks.concept.slot: Declares a named UI insertion point owned by a module.
flow.hooks.concept.provider: Registers a provider that returns a component for a qualified slot.
flow.hooks.concept.resolve: Collects provider components at render time so the owner can mount them.
flow.hooks.definition.title: Slot and provider
flow.hooks.resolve.title: Resolving
flow.hooks.resolve:
The slot owner resolves providers during render, adds returned components to the builder, and mounts their ids where the extension point belongs.

```python
components = await sdk.hooks.resolve_render_hook(
    "dashboard.after_stats",
    params=params,
    session=session,
)
for component in components:
    builder.add(component)

root = sdk.ui.Column("dashboard_root", ["stats", *[c.id for c in components]])
```
flow.hooks.discovery:
Use discovery to inspect declared slots before depending on an extension point.

```python
slots = sdk.hooks.get_render_hook_slots()
dashboard_slots = sdk.hooks.get_render_hook_slots("dashboard")
qualified = sdk.hooks.qualify_render_hook_name("dashboard.after_stats")
```
flow.hooks.api.qualify: Returns the fully qualified render-hook name for the current module.
flow.hooks.api.slots: Reads declared render-hook slot definitions, optionally filtered by module.
flow.hooks.api.resolve: Builds the components contributed by registered providers for a hook.
flow.external.check.title: Checking access
flow.external.require.title: Resumable requests
flow.external.admin.title: Approvals
flow.external.api.check: Checks the current access decision and can register a pending request.
flow.external.api.require: Checks access and attaches resume metadata for blocked work.
flow.external.api.session: Approves a pending request only for the current session scope.
flow.external.api.permanent: Persists an approval so future checks can pass without prompting.
flow.external.api.deny: Persists a denial for a reviewed external resource request.
flow.external_path.title: External Approval Path
flow.external_path.description: SDK access checks for filesystem paths outside the module boundary.
flow.external_path.overview: Use external access checks before a module reads, writes, executes, or deletes filesystem paths outside its normal boundary. The runtime resolves the current module, user, organization, session, sandbox allowlist, and previous approvals. Module code should not pass its own user/session policy flags to bypass that decision.
flow.external_path.check:
Use `check_external_access` for immediate filesystem decisions. Leave `register_request=True` when blocked access should appear in approval review; set it to `False` only for diagnostics that must not create pending requests.

```python
access = module_sdk.access.check_external_access(
    resource_type=module_sdk.access.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_FILESYSTEM,
    operation="read",
    target="/mnt/shared/input.csv",
)

if not access.allowed:
    raise PermissionError(access.message)
```
flow.external_path.require:
Use `require_external_access` when work can continue after approval. Keep `resume_context` small and idempotent: stable ids, not full payloads or secrets.

```python
access = module_sdk.access.require_external_access(
    resource_type=module_sdk.access.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_FILESYSTEM,
    operation="read",
    target=source_path,
    resume_action="my_module.resume_import",
    resume_context={"import_id": import_id},
)

if not access.allowed:
    raise PermissionError(access.message)
```
flow.external_path.admin:
Approval helpers are for review/admin flows. The approving actor is resolved by the runtime context and authorization is enforced by the access service.

```python
module_sdk.access.approve_for_session(
    resource_type=module_sdk.access.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_FILESYSTEM,
    operation="read",
    target="/mnt/shared/input.csv",
    session_key=session.get("session_key"),
)

module_sdk.access.approve_permanently(
    resource_type=module_sdk.access.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_FILESYSTEM,
    operation="read",
    target="/mnt/shared/input.csv",
)

module_sdk.access.deny_external_access(
    resource_type=module_sdk.access.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_FILESYSTEM,
    operation="read",
    target="/mnt/shared/input.csv",
)
```
flow.external_url.title: External Approval Url
flow.external_url.description: SDK access checks for HTTP and HTTPS resources outside the application boundary.
flow.external_url.overview: Use network external access checks before a module downloads from or sends data to remote URLs. Common operations are `receive` for GET/download style access and `send` for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/upload style access. Media components should receive client-safe public/proxied URLs at the UI boundary, not raw storage or local paths.
flow.external_url.check:
Use `check_external_access` before touching a remote URL. The SDK defaults the subject to the current module, and the runtime policy context supplies requester and sandbox details.

```python
access = module_sdk.access.check_external_access(
    resource_type=module_sdk.access.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_NETWORK,
    operation="receive",
    target="https://example.com/data.json",
)

if not access.allowed:
    raise PermissionError(access.message)
```
flow.external_url.require:
Use `require_external_access` for blocked network work that should resume after approval, such as model materialization or importing a remote feed.

```python
access = module_sdk.access.require_external_access(
    resource_type=module_sdk.access.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_NETWORK,
    operation="receive",
    target=model_source_url,
    resume_action="my_module.resume_model_download",
    resume_context={"download_id": download_id},
)

if not access.allowed:
    raise PermissionError(access.message)
```
flow.external_url.admin:
Session approval requires a pending request for the same session. Permanent approval is a policy decision and survives the current session.

```python
module_sdk.access.approve_for_session(
    resource_type=module_sdk.access.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_NETWORK,
    operation="receive",
    target="https://example.com/data.json",
    session_key=session.get("session_key"),
)

module_sdk.access.approve_permanently(
    resource_type=module_sdk.access.EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_NETWORK,
    operation="receive",
    target="https://example.com/data.json",
)
```
flow.permission.title: Permissions and Visibility
flow.permission.description: How module pages, actions, UI visibility, and external resources declare access boundaries.
flow.permission.overview: Use the standard SDK contracts instead of ad hoc checks scattered through UI code. Page access is declared with page decorators, action authorization with `permission_required`, component visibility with bindings/conditions and `required_permissions`, and external resources with `sdk.access`.
flow.permission.layer.page: Marks render functions that can be reached without authentication.
flow.permission.layer.action: Declares action permissions so runtime authorization can enforce them.
flow.permission.layer.ui: Controls what the client renders; it does not replace server-side authorization.
flow.permission.layer.external: Controls filesystem, network, and dependency access outside the module boundary.
flow.permission.action.title: Action authorization
flow.permission.action:
Use `permission_required` from `democrai.sdk.auth` on actions whose invocation requires permissions. The decorator attaches metadata; runtime auth enforces it at the integration point.

```python
from democrai.sdk.auth import permission_required
from democrai.sdk.decorators import action


@action("create_user")
@permission_required(["system.user.create"])
async def create_user(ctx: dict, session: dict, module_sdk):
    ...
```
flow.permission.ui.title: UI visibility
flow.permission.ui:
Use component-level visibility and permissions to keep interfaces readable, but do not treat hidden UI as authorization. Server actions must still declare or check their own access requirements.

```yaml
- kind: Button
  id: create_user
  label: Create user
  required_permissions: [system.user.create]
  action: system.create_user

- kind: Card
  id: admin_panel
  show_if:
    - left: {type: store, scope: global, path: /current_path, default: /}
      op: contains
      right: /admin
```

flow.orm.title: ORM Management
flow.orm.description: Module-owned persistence through the public sdk.database facade.
flow.orm.overview: `sdk.database` is for data owned by the module: the module defines the schema, owns the lifecycle, and persists records through the SDK boundary. Use `sdk.models` instead for platform-owned entities already exposed by core model APIs. The database facade validates module table ownership and applies runtime scope before CRUD operations.
flow.orm.boundary.module_owned_reason: The datastore rejects tables that do not use the current module prefix.
flow.orm.boundary.scope_reason: Reads and writes apply user and organization scope according to the active access context.
flow.orm.boundary.platform_reason: Core registries and platform entities are not module-owned ORM tables.
flow.orm.model.title: Models
flow.orm.model:
Declare module-owned SQLAlchemy models from the public database base. The generated table name follows `p_<module_name>_<model_name>` and the base includes user/organization scope fields.

```python
from democrai.sdk.database import Base
from sqlalchemy import String, Text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column


class Ticket(Base):
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), default="open")
    description: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, default="")
```
flow.orm.crud.title: CRUD
flow.orm.crud:
Use the facade methods instead of opening database sessions directly. Each method validates module ownership, applies scope, commits when it mutates, and returns scoped outcomes.

```python
row = module_sdk.database.add(
    Ticket(id="ticket_42", title="Broken login", status="open")
)

open_rows = module_sdk.database.list(Ticket, status="open")
loaded = module_sdk.database.get(Ticket, row.id)
updated = module_sdk.database.update(Ticket, row.id, status="closed")
deleted = module_sdk.database.delete(Ticket, row.id)
```
flow.orm.scope.title: Scope
flow.orm.scope:
The datastore receives `user_id`, `organization_id`, and `access_level` from the current runtime context. On create, scope fields are assigned when the model exposes them. On read/update/delete, scope is applied before explicit filters. Treat `None` from `get`/`update` and `False` from `delete` as normal scoped outcomes.

```python
user_id = module_sdk.database.user_id
organization_id = module_sdk.database.organization_id
access_level = module_sdk.database.access_level

rows = module_sdk.database.list(Ticket, status="open")
```
flow.orm.api.base: Declarative base for module-owned SQLAlchemy models.
flow.orm.api.add: Validates ownership, assigns scope fields when present, commits, and refreshes the row.
flow.orm.api.get: Loads one row by id inside the current module and access scope.
flow.orm.api.list: Loads scoped rows and applies equality filters for matching model attributes.
flow.orm.api.update: Updates one scoped row by id and returns the updated row or None.
flow.orm.api.delete: Deletes one scoped row by id and returns whether a row was removed.
